title: Vagus Nerve Recordings Using Carbon Fiber Microelectrode Array (CFMA)
author: Ahmad Jiman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w37fgrn

steps.title: Prepare KCl Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.3 mL of potassium chloride (KCl) solution at a concentration of 2 mEq/mL.

steps.title: Anesthetize the Animal
steps.instruction: Anesthetize a female Sprague-Dawley rat using intraperitoneal injections.

substeps.instruction: Administer initial injection of ketamine (90 mg/kg) and xylazine (10 mg/kg).
Maintain anesthesia with ketamine (30 mg/kg) injections approximately every hour.

steps.title: Isolate the Vagus Nerve
steps.instruction: Expose and isolate the left cervical vagus nerve using a midline cervical incision.

substeps.instruction: Use a dissection microscope to isolate 5-7 mm of the vagus nerve from the carotid artery and surrounding tissue.
Place the isolated nerve on a custom 3D-printed nerve holder.

steps.title: Set Up CFMA Recording System
steps.instruction: Configure the Carbon Fiber Microelectrode Array (CFMA) and visualization hardware.

substeps.instruction: Connect the CFMA to a neural interface processor (Grapevine, Ripple) via a front-end headstage (Nano 2, Ripple).
Position a small camera (MS100, Teslong) in the surgical opening to visualize fiber alignment and insertion.
Use a micromanipulator to control the headstage for accurate insertion of CFMA fibers into the vagus nerve.

steps.title: Perform Recording and KCl Application
steps.instruction: Initiate the recording trial and apply the KCl solution.

substeps.instruction: Apply 0.3 mL of KCl (2 mEq/mL) to the vagus nerve 40 seconds into the recording trial.

steps.title: Analyze Recorded Signals
steps.instruction: Process the recorded neural signals to extract specific metrics.

substeps.instruction: Sort signals for spikes using Plexon Offline Sorter.
Use MATLAB to calculate peak-to-peak voltage of spikes, conduction velocity, and noise floor.
